embeds.title: 🚀 Server Launch · Going Live!
embeds.description:
The wait is over! We launch the moment **Tshu** goes live on Twitch, so everyone can watch it happen together. 🎉
📺 **Watch the launch:** https://www.twitch.tv/tshu

✨ **What we added**
`+` **Bounties** - set bounties on players
`+` **Teams** - create your own teams
`+` **Duels** - fight players in ranked or practise casually
`+` **Black Markets** - find great deals, but be careful... he might scam you
`+` **Item of the Day Boost** - a new item every day with a sell boost

🔧 **What's enhanced**
`~` New **spawn**
`~` **Bedrock** quality of life changes
`~` **Crates**
`~` **Menu UI**
